data: © Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre / UAE Space Agency — first Arab interplanetary mission; one-Mars-day equatorial coverage.

First Arab interplanetary mission. The unusual high-altitude, low-inclination orbit lets Hope observe the same point on Mars's equator across all hours of the local day — building the first comprehensive global picture of Martian weather, atmospheric circulation, and atmospheric escape.
First Arab world interplanetary mission; first to observe Mars's full diurnal weather cycle.
